state: Static preparation complete; Native owns the remote environment and Root full R1 actual GO is pending.

frozen_input_locators.execution_argv: The sole capture owner uses the existing Root-approved prep.full_round_1 argv after actual GO; the coordinator does not execute or fabricate capture arguments.
frozen_input_locators.hash_provenance: All recorded SHA values come from existing owner-supplied preparation records. No local rehash.

admission.capture_owner_status: Root restored the sole producer; it is static-only until Native release and actual GO.
first_dispatch_requires: Root full R1 actual GO and Native environment release.
A new full R1 run/output/data identity on the frozen source and binary.
A sealed and mirrored immutable actual module with original PNG, case JSON, state, metadata, actions, log, reference and applicable HTTP/oracle/source-input SHA records.

actual_collection_mapping.native_count_basis: Use the finished manifest.native_case_inventory and actual screenshot-bearing manifest.cases. Result-only failure records are retained separately and never counted as native PNG captures.
actual_collection_mapping.required_manual_set: Use actual manifest.required_review_case_ids and every actual screenshot-bearing manual_review_required=true case; reconcile both sets before full acceptance.
actual_collection_mapping.immutable_module_boundaries: The sole producer seals the natural completion boundaries of the 17 reference boards and 21 required supplemental groups. Preserve every actual case ID and the existing capture order.
actual_collection_mapping.module_registration: Append each actual immutable module ID once with its owner manifest/inventory SHA and exact case IDs. No static numeric ranges or presumed total are assigned.
actual_collection_mapping.single_primary_owner_rule: Register each actual required manual case with one canonical batch/worker before spawning. A later mirror or reconciliation never creates a second primary owner.
actual_collection_mapping.failed_or_missing_case_rule: Retain genuine failed cases and incomplete/orphan evidence without inventing a case, skipping a required branch or granting visual/full credit.
actual_collection_mapping.final_reconciliation: At finished collection, reconcile actual cases, originals, roles, all module IDs, required manual IDs, exact references, supplemental groups and final owner inventory. Preserve original module/case bytes and use additive bindings for annotation-only final JSON changes.

batching.open_budget: manual candidate originals + unique necessary reference originals + same-case closed dependencies + necessary support/crop originals must total at most eight in one worker.
batching.partition_rule: Preserve actual module order and group related device/route comparisons; split earlier when dependencies or necessary references exceed the image budget. Do not omit a necessary comparison to fill a four-case batch.
batching.supplementary_reading_rule: An original-scale crop follow-up has a separately registered reading owner and zero additional primary manual credit; the primary case owner remains unique.
batching.model_selection: Inspect currently advertised models and capability descriptions at actual spawn time. Inherit intentionally if that metadata is insufficient; do not hardcode a model identifier.

reference_and_specification_coverage.reference_table_locator: Frozen full plan.reference_cases and reference scope.pageStateMatrix; no repeated reference SHA table is copied into this preparation.
reference_and_specification_coverage.exact_mapping: Actual case_id -> actual reference_id -> exact owner-recorded original reference path/SHA. The case reference SHA determines the immutable module reference copy; a similar basename is never substituted.
reference_and_specification_coverage.related_mapping: Non-exported and stretch states use the declared related HANDOFF/page/component contract and remain labelled related-contract comparisons, without an invented exact PNG.
reference_and_specification_coverage.support_rule: Register reference-only support separately. Overviews support topology, specification pages support global visual/interaction contracts, and pager option B is authoritative. They do not create application routes or replace actual per-case review.
reference_and_specification_coverage.support_reading_rule: After actual GO, schedule bounded fresh support reading where needed. Reuse only explicitly recorded readable reference identity/ROI observations within their scope, without claiming a new opening. Unreadable necessary text stays pending until an owner-produced original-scale crop is actually read.
reference_and_specification_coverage.native_profile_rule: Keep actual native dimensions. pw5 618x824 and Scribe 930x1240/1240x930 have factor-two handoff originals; pw6/scribe3 stretch and missing-frontlight captures are distinct related-contract states.

mandatory_fresh_scopes.normal_selected_rule: Each full round actually reads the current normal/selected original glyphs and complete 00/01/02 distinguishing identities. Font parameters, state strings, old diagnostics and qualification PASS do not substitute for this review.
mandatory_fresh_scopes.same_case_rule: Each overlay is paired only with its own fresh closed prerequisite retained first, with actual source/order/crop/processed/cache/native identity and strict zero-tolerance oracle chains. Closed prerequisites have manual_review_required=false and add no primary manual count.
mandatory_fresh_scopes.closed_reader_rule: Artwork only: no app ribbon, page/status text, footer, debug decoration or hidden footer-cycle behavior. Declared source-art borders/captions remain artwork. Screenshots do not qualify hidden hit regions or physical operation.
mandatory_fresh_scopes.capability_and_title_rule: Retain Root-confirmed truthful implemented capability/content-driven sheet bounds and independent raw/full/compact title identity. Do not manufacture unsupported controls, require every compact prefix/full title, or waive clipping/legibility/false success.

compact_report_schema.modules: Record module_id/manifest path/SHA and owner inventory SHA once per batch; keep flat canonical fields to avoid ambiguity.
compact_report_schema.cases: Record exact original PNG/final-or-immutable case JSON/state/metadata/actions/log/reference SHA, original viewing, concrete visible observation, actual data/capability boundary and bounded verdict. Retain any paired closed/crop source-output bindings.
compact_report_schema.forbidden_proof: No mechanical/state/source-parameter/old-image verdict is visual acceptance. No unexecuted operation or hardware/performance success is inferred.
compact_report_schema.write_scope: Only new full R1 inputs/reports/ledger/addenda. No production, driver, plan, qualification ledger, captured original or previous report is overwritten.

required_after_actual_capture: Versioned finished manifest/native_case_inventory and c15-full-finalization.json are complete with no terminal/initial failure.
Every original required reference, supplemental, control and fresh normal/selected/same-case scope is covered by actual current evidence.
All actual required manual cases have one fresh original review, required readable reference support, zero new required and zero reading pending.
Owner-declared source/binary/entry/plan/helper/reference/original/snapshot identities and final inventory/reconciliation are unchanged and aligned.
All Root external native/performance/resume scope gates remain required and are supplied by their authorized owners.
full_acceptance.credit_owner: Only the frozen versioned/base complete record_review logic and Root may establish clean/streak after all full visual, mechanical and external gates pass.

planned_new_outputs.output_status: Planned locators only; actual registry and batch inputs are created from new sealed modules after actual GO.

preservation.qualification_credit: 59/59 affected visual qualification is complete; full/clean/streak remain zero.
